resources.string: Use your phone as a keyboard for your PC
Point the camera at the QR code on the PC
Paste the link from the PC
The phone and the PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. On the PC, open EskaBoard to see its QR code.
Paste the link first, or scan the QR code.
This is not an EskaBoard QR code.
This is not an EskaBoard link. It looks like http://192.168.1.20:8765/?t=…#k=…
This code has expired: EskaBoard was restarted, a new QR was made, or no phone was connected for 30 minutes. Scan the new QR code.
Too many attempts with an old code. Wait a minute, then scan the new QR code.
Could not reach the PC at %1$s. Check that EskaBoard is running and that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi.

A round button over all apps; drag it anywhere. A tap takes a screenshot of the phone: it goes to the phone\'s clipboard and, when EskaBoard is connected, to the PC\'s clipboard (and Pictures/Screenshots). Android asks to display over other apps and to capture the screen: choose the entire screen.
Allow EskaBoard to display over other apps, then come back.
The floating button needs “Display over other apps”.
The floating button needs the screen capture permission.
Tap the button to take a screenshot. Tap here for settings.
Screenshot copied on the phone and the PC
Screenshot copied on the phone (PC not connected)
Screenshot copied on the phone (too large for the PC)
A second round button over all apps; drag it anywhere. A tap presses Enter on the PC while EskaBoard is connected. Android asks to display over other apps.
Tap the button to press Enter on the PC. Tap here for settings.
The floating button could not start.
A screenshot from the floating button, or a single photo sent with “Files”, is pasted at once where the PC\'s cursor is (Ctrl+V). Files are saved in Downloads/EskaBoard on the PC.
